riverpod.dev retry: "A retry is attempted when an exception is thrown during the provider's computation." "Disabling retry is as simple as always retuning `null` in the retry function." riverpod 3.0.3 element.dart: stream errors go `error: callOnError` -> triggerRetry; `if (duration == null) return;` ... `return AsyncError(error, stackTrace, retrying: false);` So with null the rethrow gives AsyncError at once; caught on Exception never reaches triggerRetry.

Flutter docs, Web FAQ "How do I configure a service worker?": "Flutter no longer generates or manages a service worker by default. If your application requires offline support or advanced caching, you need to configure a service worker yourself". DonHang.App web/index.html at stage-3 only loads `flutter_bootstrap.js`; no service worker registered. The app's files therefore come from the network or the HTTP cache.
